data.body: Fixed by Gerrit 3394 (merged 2026-11-13 12:05 PST as 57a4462e5e4, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). fsck_cli now rejects any argument left after its known flags and the output flag (`Error: unknown option '<arg>'` + usage, exit 2) and a bare `--limit` (`--limit requires a value`, exit 2), both before any store access; the --limit scan moved into `_parse_limit` (fsck_cli complexity 15 -> 14). RED tests in tests/unit/test_fsck_only_flag.py (7 failing before, 22 passing after). make verify green at 2 workers: 21285 passed + 218 integration passed. Post-merge CLI check in a scratch repo: --bogus rc=2, --repair --dryrun rc=2, --limit rc=2; --limit 1, --only stale-channel --repair --dry-run, --include-archived, --output json all rc=0. Pre-existing since fsck's hand-rolled argv scan; no culprit commit established.
